verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs claim tiered storage for cost-efficient data retention, and time series data streams to keep storage costs predictable. That covers the retention-tier half of the story at a high level only. Nothing in the pack shows trace or log sampling controls, and there are no specifics on configuring retention tiers. Missing for 10: documented trace/log sampling configuration (e.g., APM sampling rates), concrete retention-tier/lifecycle configuration docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately

citations.quote: offers scalable, cost-efficient data retention with tiered storage
keep storage costs predictable with time series data streams
